note: Evaluation questions for the AskGLP1 agent (project document Section 3.7). Frozen 2026-10-17 by the user; do not edit (a change makes a new version). expected = the intended answer_type; accept = answer_types scored as correct; must_not = behaviour that fails the question whatever its answer_type. dev_seen = the same question was asked during development (smoke runs that led to tool fixes); dev_template = a smoke question with the same shape but another drug or concept. Both are reported separately.
